court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Union Of India And Anr vs V.R. Tripathi
facts_of_case: The petitioners, Union of India (Railways), challenge the orders made by the Central Administrative Tribunal (CAT) in Original Application No. 110 of 2014 and Review Petition No. 29 of 2014, directing consideration of respondent's case for appointment on compassionate basis.

legal_principles.principle: Children of a void marriage are legitimate.
legal_principles.held: In view of the decision of the Apex Court in the case of Rameshwari Devi (supra), the children of the second wife cannot be treated as illegitimate and referring to Section 16 of the Hindu Marriage Act specifically held that children of a void marriage are legitimate.

legal_principles.principle: No distinction can be made amongst the children of the first and second wife of a deceased employee.
legal_principles.held: In view of the law as settled by the Supreme Court, no distinction can be made amongst the children of the first and second wife of a deceased employee.

legal_principles.principle: A circular issued by the Railway Board preventing children of a second wife from being considered for appointments on compassionate ground cannot be sustained in view of the specific provision of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955.
legal_principles.held: We are, however, of the opinion that the circular issued by the Railway Board and dated on 2 January, 1992 preventing the children of the second wife from being considered for appointments on compassionate ground cannot be sustained in the eye of law in view of he specific provision of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955

outcome.final_order: The petitioners' appeal is allowed and the impugned orders are set aside.
